data.name: Lumia and the Eternal Tower
data.detailed_description:
— This is the final dream witnessed by Lumia, a lone warrior —

Lumia, a young girl who has survived a world torn apart by endless war,
is suddenly engulfed by a mysterious light during a mission
and falls into an unfamiliar world.

When she awakens, she finds a boy dressed in white standing before her—
and a colossal tower rising endlessly into the sky.

Guided by the boy, Lumia resolves to climb the tower
in order to return to her original world,
believing that hope awaits her at its summit.

■ About the Game

Lumia and the Eternal Tower is an action RPG brought to life
with beautifully crafted, fantastical pixel art.

The game features smooth, responsive controls and a satisfying sense of weight,
along with ever-changing gimmicks and stage structures
that evolve as you ascend the tower.

■ Key Features

  • A wide variety of combat styles through customizable weapons and modules

  • Procedurally changing stages and monsters with every run

  • A natural fusion of side-scrolling action and roguelike RPG mechanics

  • A dreamlike world that feels both nostalgic and mysterious

  • Dialogue events and short stories featuring memorable characters

Within the tower, what you encounter—
is it reality, or merely a dream?

As Lumia descends deeper into the tower,
the shape of a “wish” she herself does not yet realize
begins to take form.

What kind of view awaits you
at the very top of the tower?

This game is currently under development.
Content is subject to change through future updates.

data.short_description: —This is the final dream witnessed by Lumia, a lone warrior.— A roguelike action RPG. Ascend the 99 floors of the Eternal Tower in a world blending 2D and 3D effects. Each run reshapes stages, enemies, and combat with weapons and Modules. Will you reach the top, and what choice awaits Lumia?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended
